knownFailuresAndUnresolved.reason: UA p.26 row says Aklys without qualifier; frozen record is specifically “Aklys (hurled)”. Do not assume row fact applies to all Aklys use variants.
Legible Jo Stick row has no frozen equipment owner and is distinct from PHB Bo Stick.
Legible hand-quarrel row has no frozen equipment item. Do not map to hand crossbow or the separately priced “Quarrels for same” row.
Source row combines blowgun and needle; existing ua-blowgun-needle fields state combined weight/damage. No value is attributable to needle or blowgun alone.
Light-, medium-, and heavy-horse rows are distinct. Each maps only to generic phb-lance as a context pointer; no variant values are collapsed into generic item fields.
Armor Class table says only “shield”; no shield size/type. Candidate shield item mappings remain uncertain.
No distinct “elfin chain mail” record exists; it remains a variant label and is not equated with ordinary chain mail.
The facing-page notes are visible, but exact marker glyph strings for Glaive, Guisarme, and Guisarme-Voulge are not reliable enough in the available p.26 render; retain unresolved marker strings.

repairStatus: No UA26 repair was applied before baseline capture.
